integrity_statement: The pmf and order comparisons are justified by exact matching enumeration and algebra. Finite verification is corroborative and not substituted for proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only a single distinguished chord in a uniform finite fixed-size chord diagram is analyzed.
The result does not classify all nonadjacent opposite-parity comparisons.
Full independent historical-priority and correctness audit has not been performed.
title: Parity-separated likelihood-ratio ordering and adjacent incomparability for random chord degrees
